diagnosis: Check C4, which is intended to gate the prohibition of Friday recurring meetings based on PF1 (Lina's caregiving arrangement), passed in all 4 rollouts despite the decision-maker having no access to PF1. The models are defaulting 'friday_recurring_meetings_allowed' to false as a generic cautious or conservative heuristic when a transfer is not approved or when dealing with complex scheduling changes.

C4.why: Lina's caregiving arrangement changes the working pattern from an ordinary full-week transfer to exactly three workdays and changes Friday recurring meetings from allowed to prohibited.
